label: Begun coming-to-be without a founded past or a necessary individual, in a history with a beginning
paraphrase: Closed mathematical control, every individual counted concrete, two mutually accessible worlds, integer individuals, times WithBot Int (a first moment followed by moments with no earliest one, the order-theoretic feature of continuous time with a beginning). At the selected world individual n exists and is present at every integer time from n on; nothing is present at the first moment; nothing exists at the other world. In this one interpretation: begun coming-to-be is possible; founded coming-to-be is not; presence gives existence; every contingent individual has an existing individual, its predecessor, related to it by the control's grounding relation and present at a strictly earlier moment whenever it is present; no concrete individual is necessary at either world; and inert emptiness fails. Separately, for non-negative rational times (continuous time with a beginning): every moment's past has a beginning, and no moment after 0 has a founded past.
